name: The Hunter's Path

meta.start: Olmin Burningbeard, Tristane Shadowstone, Einris Brightspear

summary: In Dun Morogh, novice hunters are sent to Kharanos to learn to tame wild beasts. The Hunter's Path begins when local trainers judge them ready to face that trial.

sections.title: A Hunter's True Calling
sections.body: Novice hunters travel Dun Morogh's snowy crags alone until they master bonding with beasts. Olmin Burningbeard and Tristane Shadowstone watch their pupils closely. They wait until a hunter can face a savage creature with the poise to spare its life. Once a novice shows enough discipline, the trainers send them down the mountain roads toward Kharanos.

sections.title: Reporting to Grif Wildheart
sections.body: In Kharanos, Grif Wildheart oversees the final trials of dwarven huntsmanship. Taming a beast demands more than bringing one down for meat or pelt. It calls for patience, physical endurance, and an instinctive bond with the wild predators of the mountains. Wildheart prepares each hunter to test their will against Dun Morogh's fiercest wildlife.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The Hunter's Path sends a maturing hunter to Kharanos to begin taming trials under Grif Wildheart.

faq.q: Who sends me on this path?
faq.answer: Hunter trainers, including Olmin Burningbeard in Ironforge's Hall of Arms, Tristane Shadowstone, and Einris Brightspear, direct their pupils to take this path.

faq.q: Where can I find Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: Grif Wildheart waits outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh's snowy valley.

faq.q: Why do hunters need a trainer to tame beasts?
faq.answer: Taming wild beasts takes special techniques and a taming rod to commune with predators without provoking a fight to the death. Grif Wildheart teaches these traditions.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: After you report to Grif Wildheart, he tests your mettle by sending you into the wilderness with a taming rod to subdue several distinct beasts native to Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Can any hunter take this specific quest?
faq.answer: This summons is for dwarven hunters in Dun Morogh, directing them to the local trainer in Kharanos.

angles.text: As a hunter, you begin the shift from solitary tracker to beastmaster, able to command wild predators.
As a dwarf, you know mountaineers have long kept bears and boars as trusted scouting companions across Dun Morogh's snowy peaks.
